say:1:1064305001:0.text: After a night of urgent repairs, the contest venue reopens the following afternoon, with the protective barrier around the stands reinforced.
say:1:1064305001:0.source_cn: 经过连夜抢修，比赛会场于当日下午再度开放，看台四周的防...

say:2:1064305002:0.text: Palpable excitement ripples through the audience. Gonrad takes the stage, feeding off their energy and amplifying it with every move.
say:2:1064305002:0.source_cn: 观众们的表情中流露出期待与难以掩饰的紧张，主持人冈罗站...

say:4:1064305003:0.text:
Ladies and gentlemen, after two rounds of heart-pounding—
Or should I say, explosive—matches, the much-awaited grand finals are here!
say:4:1064305003:0.source_cn: 女士们！先生们！历经两轮惊心动魄、精彩绝伦——\n或者...

say:5:1064305004:0.text: In this final showdown, two master craftsmen will demonstrate the pinnacle of weapon forging!
say:5:1064305004:0.source_cn: 两位技艺登峰造极的大师，将在决赛，为我们呈现何为最强武...

say:6:1064305005:0.text:
Our first finalist is Kornuk, known for his robust craftsmanship!
Next up, we have the mysterious contestant from Workshop Eight! His creations have quite literally blown us away!
say:6:1064305005:0.source_cn: 他们分别是——以厚重与力量著称的矮人锻造大师，寇恩！\...

say:7:1064305006:0.text: The audience bursts into rapturous cheers, much louder than those for Kornuk.
say:7:1064305006:0.source_cn: 观众席爆发出狂热的声浪，八号的呼喊声明显要高于寇恩。

say:8:1064305007:0.text: The rules for the finals are all about simplicity. Finalists, you have one day to forge your creations, with no restrictions on materials, design, or weapon type!
say:8:1064305007:0.source_cn: 决赛规则，极致纯粹！限时一天，材料、形式、种类无限制！

say:9:1064305008:0.text: Draw upon everything you have learned and forge your ultimate weapon!
say:9:1064305008:0.source_cn: 请两位大师，倾尽你们的智慧与技艺，锻造出你们心目中，那...

say:10:1064305009:0.text:
Tomorrow, right here, one of you will be crowned the champion!
Let the finals begin!
say:10:1064305009:0.source_cn: 明天，依然在这片会场，将角逐出最强武器锻造大师！\n比...

say:14:1064305010:0.text: Hey, Metalhead, heard that? You're free to make whatever you want in the finals. That's right up your alley!
say:14:1064305010:0.source_cn: 喂，铁块头！决赛题目你听到了吧，无限制，是不是正合你意。

say:15:1064305011:0.text: Whatever nightmare you create this time, I won't back an eyelid!
say:15:1064305011:0.source_cn: 这次，无论你想做什么武器，我都已经完全过敏了。

say:17:1064305012:0.text: No offense, Lady Kulu, but don't you mean "bat" an eyelid?
say:17:1064305012:0.source_cn: 库露露大人想说的应该是，脱敏吧?

say:19:1064305013:0.text: Uh... w-whatever! You know what I mean!

say:20:1064305014:0.text:
Ultimate weapon.
Doomstar. My finest cannon.
say:20:1064305014:0.source_cn: 最强武器。\n终极大炮，末日陨星。

say:21:1064305015:0.text: That's a brilliant name. I've got to say, you do have a knack for naming things.
say:21:1064305015:0.source_cn: 听起来挺气派，也够时髦。在起名字这件事上，我还是比较欣...

say:22:1064305016:0.text:
Refined abyssal energy. As core power source.
Boosts impact fivefold.
say:22:1064305016:0.source_cn: 精粹深渊之力，作核心能量。\n冲击力，五倍攀升。

say:23:1064305017:0.text:
Warhead. Crucial.
Enchanted and reforged with high-purity <style="highlight">soul crystals</style>.
say:23:1064305017:0.source_cn: 弹头，火力核心。\n以高纯度<style=highli...

say:24:1064305018:1.text:
Wait, soul crystals?! I-I'm definitely batting my eyelids now...
If I remember correctly, those crystals are made by <style="highlight">refining the souls of sentient beings</style>!
say:24:1064305018:1.source_cn: 灵魂晶石？！我、我又不脱敏了……\n没记错的话，那东西...

say:25:1064305019:1.text: Soul crystals are common in the abyss, but this is human territory! They're <style="highlight">absolutely forbidden</style> here!
say:25:1064305019:1.source_cn: 深渊下面不难搞到，但这是人类世界！<style=hig...

say:26:1064305020:1.text: If you're thinking of opening another portal to the abyss to fetch some, forget it right now!
say:26:1064305020:1.source_cn: 你该不会又想开个门回深渊去拿吧？绝对不行！上次的账还没...

say:27:1064305021:1.text:
No. I need Hypogean servants.
Too inefficient. If I transport them myself.
say:27:1064305021:1.source_cn: 不。缺少恶魔仆从。\n仅我运送，效率评估，过低。

say:28:1064305022:0.text:
Use whatever I can find. Here.
As supplies.
say:28:1064305022:0.source_cn: 人类世界，就地取材。\n以充军资。

say:30:1064305024:1.text:
Villages, towns, cities.
Humans. Renewable resource. Ample reserves.
say:30:1064305024:1.source_cn: 村，镇，城。\n人类，可再生，储量充足。

say:31:1064305025:1.text:
Special abyssal furnace. Built.
Fast extraction. For finals.
say:31:1064305025:1.source_cn: 特制深渊熔炉，已组装。\n高效提取，以备明日竞赛。

say:32:1064305026:1.text: H-Hey, humans aren't lumber! We're both Hypogeans... How can you be so ruthless?!
say:32:1064305026:1.source_cn: 你、你你你，你把人类当木材了？大家都是恶魔，你怎么能这...

say:33:1064305027:1.text:
Material sourcing. Avoid competition personnel and venue.
Final testing. Proceed as planned.
say:33:1064305027:1.source_cn: 取材，将规避比赛人员及，场地。\n确保，最终测试开展。

say:35:1064305029:1.text: Gunnar, I cut you slack because you're a fan and you actually know weapons. That changes now.
say:35:1064305029:1.source_cn: 唉，本来呢，看在你是我的粉丝，还挺懂火力的份上，我考虑...

say:36:1064305030:1.text: You've proved to me time and again that you're nothing but a hopeless weapon maniac!
say:36:1064305030:1.source_cn: 但现在，我确定了，勒图姆，你就是个无药可救、最最最老土...

say:37:1064305031:1.text:
Trying to talk sense into someone like you is the stupidest thing I've ever done!
I'm sending you back to the abyss, even if it means doing things the old-fashioned way!
say:37:1064305031:1.source_cn: 跟你这种家伙讲道理，是我这辈子做过最蠢最蠢的事！\n本...

say:38:1064305032:0.text: Zanie! Elijah! Lailah! You heard that, right? I've given up on him. He's all yours!
say:38:1064305032:0.source_cn: 祖娅！伊莱亚！莱拉！你们听到了吧，我决定不感化他了，交...

say:41:1064305033:0.text: At Kulu's cue, the trio enters the workshop. Zanie wears a grim expression, while Elijah and Lailah remain calm.
say:41:1064305033:0.source_cn: 库露露话音刚落，三人走入工坊，是面色阴沉的祖娅，还有平...

say:42:1064305034:0.text: <style="highlight">Kulu turned to them for help after Gunnar's behavior crossed the line</style>.

say:43:1064305035:0.text: Hmph, at least you came to your senses before it was too late, Kulu. I may go a little easier on you this time.
say:43:1064305035:0.source_cn: 哼哼，算你及时回头，库露露，这次可以考虑少追究你一些责任。

say:44:1064305036:0.text: Metalhead, are you seriously planning to turn the villagers into soul crystals? Over my dead body!
say:44:1064305036:0.source_cn: 铁块头，听说你要用村子里的大家做什么材料，我可不允许！

say:47:1064305037:0.text: To burn living souls as fuel is an unforgivable sin, even for Hypogeans.
say:47:1064305037:0.source_cn: 以生灵为薪柴，纵然是来自深渊的恶魔，亦为悖逆。

say:48:1064305038:0.text: Such evil intent breeds calamity. It must be stopped.
say:48:1064305038:0.source_cn: 这般恶念，实为灾厄，其行应当停止。

say:50:1064305039:0.text: Elijah and Lailah position themselves in formation. The intricate starry magic circle beneath them radiates dazzling light, enveloping the workshop in its energy!
say:50:1064305039:0.source_cn: 伊莱亚和莱拉联结站定，脚下繁复的星辰封印法阵光芒大盛，...

say:53:1064305040:1.text:
Stellar energy. Pure. Efficient.
Excellent energy source. Jotted down.
say:53:1064305040:1.source_cn: 星辰之力，纯净，高效。\n优质改装能量，已记录。

say:55:1064305041:0.text: Can you believe this? Even with death staring him in the face, all he can think about is weapons! Zanie! Elijah! Lailah! Get him!
say:55:1064305041:0.source_cn: 你看他！你看他！死到临头还只想着武器！祖娅，伊莱亚，莱...

say:57:1064305042:0.text: Gunnar points his cannon at Kulu and the others, ominous energy surging and converging at the barrel…
say:57:1064305042:0.source_cn: 勒图姆的炮管瞄向四人，毁灭能量沸腾汇聚……

say:58:1064305043:0.text:
Doomstar prototype.
Collect combat data samples.
say:58:1064305043:0.source_cn: 末日陨星原型机。\n收集，实战数据样本。

say:64:1064305045:0.text: Following a thunderous boom, a pillar of light surges skyward, shaking the entire Brimstone Village!
say:64:1064305045:0.source_cn: 恐怖的爆炸声和冲天而起的星辉光柱，惊动了整个深岩村！

say:65:1064305046:0.text: Gunnar's guffaw rings out through the relentless bombardment...
say:65:1064305046:0.source_cn: 勒图姆在狂轰滥炸中发出大笑，声音透过爆炸声传出……

say:67:1064305048:0.text:
This contest.
Only I. Can be the champion!
say:67:1064305048:0.source_cn: 武器锻造竞赛。\n冠军，唯我！

say:68:1064305049:1.text:
Gunnar's barrage wreaks havoc all around him.
Thanks to the combined efforts of Kulu and the others, Gunnar's power was contained within the workshop. Otherwise, the entire Brimstone Village would have been reduced to ashes.
say:68:1064305049:1.source_cn: 勒图姆的炮火肆虐轰击四周。\n所幸库露露四人合力，将勒...

say:69:1064305050:0.text: As the sky darkens, stellar energy intensifies. The magic circle slowly closes in, suppressing Gunnar and his raging firepower.
say:69:1064305050:0.source_cn: 天色渐晚，星辰之力越来越盛，封印法阵缓慢收拢，将勒图姆...

say:70:1064305051:0.text: Even as the sealing closes around him, Gunnar is still marveling at the immense power of the stellar energy. His voice drips with unbridled admiration.
say:70:1064305051:0.source_cn: 在封印完成前一刻，勒图姆仍在为星辰之力的强大力量发出赞...

say:71:1064305052:1.text:
Stellar energy. So powerful.
Data collected.
say:71:1064305052:1.source_cn: 星辰之力，强力能量。\n数据，已收集。

say:72:1064305053:1.text:
Doomstar. To be remade.
Modification plan...
say:72:1064305053:1.source_cn: 重制，究极末日陨星。\n改装方案，已……

say:74:1064305054:1.text: Before he can finish, Gunnar is dragged into a temporary abyssal rift by force. When the chaos finally subsides, only ruins remain...
say:74:1064305054:1.source_cn: 话音未落，勒图姆被强行封入临时撕开的深渊裂隙。一切平息...

say:76:1064305055:0.text: ... That crazy, obsessive fool! He was still talking about modifying his cannon at the very end!
say:76:1064305055:0.source_cn: ……这个笨蛋、疯子、偏执狂！最后喊的居然还是武器改装！

say:77:1064305056:1.text: As formidable as he and his cannon may be, he never stood a chance against the wise and mighty Lady Kulu!
say:77:1064305056:1.source_cn: 不过，在英明神武的库露露大人面前，就算是这种武器狂人，...

say:80:1064305057:0.text: Obsession, when left to fester, can give rise to a power that brings ruin to all things.
say:80:1064305057:0.source_cn: 纯粹的痴迷，可化为摧毁万物的存在。

say:81:1064305058:0.text: Only the eternal starlight can stand watch against such beings.
say:81:1064305058:0.source_cn: 对此等存在，需以永恒的星光加以警惕。

say:82:1064305059:0.text: The danger is far from over.

say:83:1064305060:0.text: The seal is only a temporary measure.

say:86:1064305061:0.text: Kulu! Next time, when you meet a stranger...

say:87:1064305062:0.text: *Crying*... Sorry, Zanie... It was my bad...
say:87:1064305062:0.source_cn: 呜……呜呜呜……对不起，祖娅……我知道错了……

say:88:1064305063:0.text: Tsk, you know I can never stay mad at you. At least the biggest trouble is out of the way for now. We can take our time cleaning up the mess.
say:88:1064305063:0.source_cn: 唉，真是拿你没办法，所幸最大的麻烦暂时送走了。剩下的烂...

say:90:1064305064:0.text: Beneath the night sky, Brimstone Village echoes with the cries of survivors and hushed words of consolation in the wake of the disaster...
say:90:1064305064:0.source_cn: 夜空下，深岩村回荡起劫后余生的哭泣与慰问……

say:91:1064305065:0.text: Over time, Gunnar's story evolves into multiple versions, shared and retold in taverns, at docks, and in workshops...
say:91:1064305065:0.source_cn: 随时间流逝，勒图姆的恐怖传说演变为各种版本，在酒馆、码...
